purpose: A second independently curated batch of natural single-page text questions for an 80-question cumulative Answer evaluation
selectionPolicy: Freeze each question and reference answer only after checking the indexed evidence and the original PDF page.
Use natural entity- or topic-scoped wording without file names, document IDs, page numbers, answer leakage, or hidden retrieval hints.
Require one physical Gold page containing all material evidence for the answer.
Exclude questions that require visual interpretation, table reconstruction, cross-page aggregation, or ambiguous document-relative wording.
Prefer direct factual, definitional, procedural, and short-list questions across distinct domains and documents.
